name: @arena/expert-engagement-service
description: Arena expert-engagement reference service (Work Order C011; issue #117). In-process service over @arena/expert-engagement: offer issue/accept/decline/expire/withdraw/replace/activate/complete operations wired to the C001 escalation lifecycle (closed state-binding allowlists — drift fails closed with ESCALATION_STATE_MISMATCH) and the C002 routing shortlists (an offer may only be issued to an expert on a MATCHED verdict's shortlist — never an off-shortlist offer) through INJECTED ports; the C010 commercial offer/budget-hold records are resolved as OPAQUE PUBLIC REFS only (this service owns NO money truth — lock rule 33). Availability declarations are versioned with strictly-superseding versions; the deterministic offer-time availability resolution recomputes capacity from the accepted/active commitment set so a declared window can NEVER be overcommitted (CAPACITY_EXCEEDED). Serves the ES1.0 current-availability routing-input projection the C002 seam reads (a projection, never a write into routing). SLA clock evaluation runs as a DURABLE IDEMPOTENT, correlation-addressable job on the A015 job-fabric seam; breached clocks are appended once as content-addressed breach records (first observation canonical — append-only events with reasons; measurements only, enforcement belongs downstream). Commands carry REQUIRED idempotency keys (lock rule 17); duplicate acceptance REPLAYS the recorded outcome (typed duplicate, never a double-commit); cross-tenant access fails closed; tampered store entries fail closed with digest re-verification; all times are injected — no hidden clocks.
